mapper.select: SELECT b.id, b.user_id AS userId, b.title, b.description, b.images, b.cover_url AS coverUrl, b.comments, b.publish_time AS publishTime, u.nick_name AS name, u.icon FROM tb_blog b JOIN tb_user u ON u.id = b.user_id WHERE b.status = 1 ORDER BY b.liked DESC, b.publish_time DESC, b.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
